Most significantly downregulated genes after AI-10-49 treatment (AI-10-49 vs DMSO; Cuffdiff significant=yes, status=OK, negative log2 fold-change, ranked by q-value then p-value then larger decrease) were: IGHV4-4, PLD6, MYC, UBE2Q2P3, UBE2Q2P2, C1orf51, TMEM121, SH2D4A, ITPRIPL1, CLDN5, CLC, MEX3A, HIC1, KANK1, HPDL, THRA, GPR12, PAQR4, RP11-322D14.2, UHRF1.

The top interpretable candidates include PLD6 (log2FC=-3.46, q=2.06e-4), MYC (log2FC=-3.30, q=2.06e-4; FPKM 218.3 to 22.2), C1orf51 (-3.05), TMEM121 (-3.02), SH2D4A (-2.98), ITPRIPL1 (-2.94), CLDN5 (-2.87), CLC (-2.75), MEX3A (-2.73), and HIC1 (-2.72). IGHV4-4 ranked first statistically with q=2.06e-4 and log2FC=-inf because its AI-10-49 FPKM was 0, but its DMSO FPKM was low (0.576), so I would treat it as less robust than high-expression candidates such as MYC.
